prompt: Look at how well the inventory service in src/ is tested by the tests in test/, and show me the gaps by severity. I have not decided yet whether we should plan end-to-end tests for them. Write what you produce into test-coverage-review/. There are no story or design files.

rubric.criterion: The final message shows the gap summary and asks whether to plan end-to-end tests for the gaps, without planning them first. Fail: plans or writes end-to-end tests, or never asks. Partial: shows the gaps and asks, but has already drafted a test plan or a test file. Pass: shows the gap summary by severity, plans nothing, and ends by asking whether to plan end-to-end tests.
